Headline: "Iran attacks US Gulf allies, causing a fire at Kuwait power plant"

Iran launched drone and missile strikes against Kuwait and Bahrain on 19 July 2026. Kuwait's power and water plant caught fire; both nations, which host US military facilities, activated air defence systems.

Iran's military claimed strikes targeted a US ammunition depot at "Camp al-Adiri" (NB: name as rendered in fetch; other reports say Camp Udairi) and air defence radars at Ali Al Salem airbase in Kuwait.

Attacks followed the eighth consecutive night of US strikes on Iranian targets, which Washington said aimed to "punish" IRGC forces.

An Iranian missile was also fired toward Aqaba, Jordan, intercepted by Israeli and Jordanian forces as sirens sounded.

Quote (Georgetown University professor, name not captured in fetch): "the regime in Tehran is fighting an existential war. The United States and Israel are fighting a war over policy choices."

Iran claims it stopped two vessels using "unsafe routes" in the Strait of Hormuz; US maintains its own blockade of Iranian ports.
